## FileWireSchema variable

Schema for the payload of a `file` control record: file metadata and the runtime-issued fetch grant.

**Signature:**

```typescript
FileWireSchema: z.ZodType<FileWire>
```

## Remarks

The payload has the keys `path` (optional text), `exists` (a boolean), `observedAt` (a date control record, validated by [WireDateSchema](./contracts.wiredateschema.md)<!-- -->), and `grant` (non-empty text), and no others.
